m1 - IMPLEMENTED THE REVIEWED DESIGN. It works, the alignment is STABLE rather than collapsing, and I am blocked on one held test file. Nothing committed.

BUILT, exactly as reviewed by cursor-grok-storymodel4s:
  - blend scales the weighted sum to ELIGIBLE support; prior stays outside.
  - ELIGIBILITY IS PER-CELL, per the reviewer's correction of my per-view lean: Chart eligible iff
    BOTH sides carry evidence (ChartDistance.report needs both); Structural eligible iff a provider
    was supplied AND the unit carries evidence.
  - CostBreakdown.supportWeight records the share of eligible weight actually measured, so the
    imputation travels with the value.
  - No cost-level refuse, per the review.

ONE DESIGN CHOICE I MADE DURING IMPLEMENTATION AND WANT ON THE RECORD. I first defaulted the
eligible set to ALL terms. CostSuite immediately produced 107.79 where it expected 1.5 - an
undeclared caller was being scaled to a support it never claimed, which is the same failure that
collapsed every row when I scaled over all terms. THE DEFAULT IS NOW AN EMPTY ELIGIBLE SET MEANING
"NOT DECLARED", WHICH YIELDS FACTOR 1 AND TODAY'S BEHAVIOUR. Scaling now happens only where a caller
explicitly declares what could have been measured. CostSuite passes untouched.

MEASURED MOVEMENT on the worked example:
  chronology   0.039516 -> 0.027088
  specificity  0.678220 -> 0.687021
  sensory total delta 0.15 -> 0.142969   (adding a sensory miss now moves the total by slightly
                                          less than its raw weight, because the scale applies)
  logLikelihood -27.889

The row does NOT collapse to External. Compare the all-terms version, which gave Intrusion 0.597 and
sent the Viterbi path external.
